H2OH03125.name: Joyce Beatty
H2OH03125.bio: U.S. Representative for Ohio's 3rd District since 2013; former Ohio House Democratic leader and Ohio State University senior vice president.

positions.stance: Supports legislation ensuring every Central Ohioan can earn a livable wage, equal pay for equal work, and more investment in workforce training and education.
Fighting to reduce the cost of college, increase investment in public schools, address the student loan debt crisis, and expand access to STEM fields.
"Healthcare is a right, not just a privilege for the financially fortunate"; supports expanding and strengthening the Affordable Care Act.
Supports expanding Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid, and strengthening these programs to ensure their long-term solvency.
Working to address unequal pay, sexual harassment, and threats to "a woman's right to choose and access to birth control."
"Gentrification of housing in my district."
"The city is facing a significant, worsening shortage of affordable housing, with the Mid-Ohio Regional Planning Commission (MORPC) projecting a population of 3 million by 2050."
"Better relationship with our police force."
"Homelessness and opioid addiction rehab."
"Property taxes and home improvement grants."

S6OH00163.name: Sherrod Brown
S6OH00163.bio: Former U.S. Senator from Ohio, born and raised in Mansfield.

positions.stance: "It's time to ban health insurance companies from denying the care your doctor says you need," and fine insurers that deny claims.
"Let's make it illegal for drug companies to charge Americans more than they do in other countries."
Require data centers "to pay the full cost of their utilities so your bills don't go up," and let Ohioans decide whether data centers are built locally.
Cap "how much utility companies can raise your rates" so bills are affordable and predictable.
Ban members of Congress and their spouses from trading stocks, and bar members from becoming lobbyists after they leave office.

S6OH00304.name: Jon Husted
S6OH00304.bio: U.S. Senator from Ohio (appointed January 2025); former Ohio lieutenant governor, secretary of state, and Ohio House speaker.

S6OH00395.name: Gregory Lee Levy
S6OH00395.bio: Community organizer, U.S. military veteran, and mover from Akron.

positions.stance: "We are building a socialist movement to end the rule of the billionaires once and for all."
Take the 100 biggest corporations into public ownership; enact a national rent cap at 20% of income, single-payer health care, and free public education through college.
"Outlaw corporate lobbying and political donations" and move to abolish the Senate and Supreme Court, "transferring their powers to more democratic and accountable bodies."
Calls for "full payment of reparations to Black Americans for slavery and Jim Crow dictatorship" and placing police departments under direct community control.
"Slash the Pentagon budget by 90%," dismantle U.S. military bases abroad, and dissolve NATO, the CIA and AFRICOM.

S6OH00429.name: William Redpath
S6OH00429.bio: Certified public accountant and retired business valuation professional; former chair of the Libertarian National Committee.

positions.stance: Calls U.S. participation in the war against Iran "clearly unconstitutional" and says Donald Trump should be impeached and removed for not seeking Congressional approval.
"The United States should end all tariffs on imported goods and services, regardless of the policies of other nations."
Endorses allowing all immigration except "criminals, terrorists, the seriously ill, or others who would harm the life, liberty, and property of people here."
Favors a BRAC-style Social Security reform commission, paying Medicare enrollees in cash, and turning Medicaid over to the states over ten years.
Calls for eliminating the Departments of Education and Housing & Urban Development and ending all corporate welfare and farm subsidies.
